Hi,

Thanks for letting us know. We generated a one-time reset for server X, but the reset token is restricted to internal admin use and cannot be shared with external third parties. For security reasons we cannot forward the code to external addresses.

Next steps we can take immediately to get you back in:
- Open an admin handoff ticket to admin-team@company.com so they can perform the reset and re-enable access for your authorized contact; or
- Arrange a timed admin session (please provide the name and corporate email of the authorized person from your team and a preferred 30-minute window in UTC), during which our admin team will grant access and verify connectivity.

Please let us know which option you prefer and provide the authorized contact details if choosing the timed session. If you believe you already have an internal admin account that should receive the code, provide that corporate account email and we will verify and proceed.

Regards,
Support Team
me@company.com
